briefdescription.para: Activate and configure a subsystem's preallocated devices.

detaileddescription.para: Marks a powered-off subsystem online, requests each unallocated preallocated device, and sets SUBSYSTEM_IS_CONFIGURED after all requests succeed.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if already configured or all preallocations succeed; XST_INVALID_PARAM for a NULL subsystem; XST_FAILURE for malformed requirement data; or XPM_ERR_DEVICE_REQ if a device request fails.

briefdescription.para: Add a node-class-specific requirement to a subsystem.

detaileddescription.para: Dispatches the request using the class of the node ID in Payload[1]. A device request adds a device requirement, a reset request grants reset permission, a subsystem request grants operation permissions, and a register node request adds register-node access.

Subsystem
Pointer to the subsystem receiving the requirement. Must not be NULL.
Payload
Command payload whose second word contains the node ID. Must contain at least two words; class-specific handlers can require additional words.
PayloadLen
Number of words available in Payload.
XST_SUCCESS if the selected requirement was added.
XST_INVALID_PARAM for an unsupported node class or a malformed class-specific payload.
An error status returned by the selected requirement handler.

briefdescription.para: Shut down a subsystem and release its runtime resources.

detaileddescription.para: An already powered-off subsystem is accepted without further action. Otherwise this function idles its cores, clears its configured and idle- callback flags, releases all requirements, unregisters all notifiers, clears the pending callback reason, and changes the state to POWERED_OFF. Processing stops at the first failed step, so effects completed before that failure remain in place.

Subsystem
Pointer to the subsystem to shut down. Must not be NULL.
XST_SUCCESS if the subsystem was already off or shutdown completed.
An error status returned by the idle, cleanup, or state-change step.
Strong symbol override - full implementation for subsystem builds. Shut down a subsystem and release its runtime resources.

parameterdescription.para: Subsystem to shut down; unused by this EEMI stub.
